analysis: Saved-score aggregation only; no simulations or physical calculations were run.

retained_archived_rotated_branches_equal.basis: The retained maps have no saved rotated arm rows; the established wall_fit helper therefore reuses their archived nominal rows.

score_definition.eligible_section_weighted: Sum each per-map absolute map-mean error multiplied by that map's common eligible-section count, divided by the total eligible-section count. This changes only the weights on within-map absolute errors. It is not the per-wall absolute-error average, not a new fit, and not an estimate of between-map or device uncertainty.
score_definition.equal_map: Arithmetic mean of the per-map absolute map-mean errors; every map has equal weight.

intensity_fits.separate_disjoint: Target-map coefficients fitted with wall-cut pixels and buffer excluded.
intensity_fits.transferred_even: Primary coefficients transferred from the four other maps.

score_definition.map_error: For each map, barrier, family and intensity fit, calculate predicted-minus-measured width residuals over the same common sections. Average signed residuals separately by diffraction order; take the absolute value of each order mean; average the two order errors.

limitation: All results condition on the saved scans, material records, probe settings, common fit-qualified walls and specified aggregation. The OLS diagnostic has six map-level observations. Spatial sections are not independent maps or devices.

cohort.eligibility: A source wall is retained only when measured, periodic-network, and isolated-wall scan-grid fits qualify in both diffraction orders.

fixed_model_five_map_gains_after_droppin.definition: For each omitted map, recompute equal-map MAE for the fixed network and isolated predictions on the other five maps; gain is isolated MAE minus network MAE.

leave_one_map_out_ols.comparison_note: The OLS errors are held-out by map. Network and isolated scores are fixed-physics map-mean errors on the same six maps; those physical predictions are not refit to the measured map-mean width gaps. A positive advantage means lower error than OLS.
leave_one_map_out_ols.model: Ordinary least squares with one linear predictor and an intercept.
leave_one_map_out_ols.predictor: Median retained wall-row spacing per map (nm)
leave_one_map_out_ols.response: Map-mean measured first-order minus second-order fitted width (nm)

reproduction_command: From the extracted paper root: python3 analysis/summarize_mos2_spacing_and_weighting.py
